name: Academic Research Skills (ARS-Codex)
description: Complete academic research suite replicating ARS-Codex: 10-stage research pipeline orchestrator, Socratic RQ guidance, 3W literature matrix, Crossref DOI verification, 7-category integrity gates, claim-faithfulness alignment, style calibration, and peer review coaching. Ready out-of-the-box.
whenToUse: Use throughout the entire scholarly research lifecycle: RQ formulation, PRISMA literature reviews, manuscript drafting, academic integrity auditing, multi-perspective peer review, rebuttal coaching, and publication-ready formatting.

pipeline_stage_orchestrator.description: ARS 10-stage pipeline orchestrator: detect current research phases, generate Material Passports, plan sequential next steps, and enforce human confirmation checkpoints.

socratic_research_guide.description: Socratic research mentor & RQ blueprint builder: multi-layer heuristic dialogue transforming vague topics into precise scientific questions with FINER feasibility & novelty scoring.

verify_doi.description: Verify paper DOIs via the Crossref API to validate literature authenticity, extract titles, authors, journals, publication years, citation counts, and abstracts to prevent academic hallucinations. No API key required.

search_crossref.description: Search the official Crossref database by keywords, title, or author to retrieve published papers with verified DOIs and bibliographic metadata to prevent fabricated citations.

three_way_lit_scan.description: 3W literature matrix scanner (Why problem/gap, How methodology/controls, What findings/bounds) synthesizing cross-study agreements, conflicts, and open theoretical gaps.

academic_integrity_audit.description: Blocking academic integrity gate (Stage 2.5 / 4.5): audit manuscripts against 7 structural AI failure modes (hallucinated references, overclaiming, baseline flaws, p-hacking, etc.).

academic_paper_analysis.description: Structured literature analysis tool: decompose abstracts, methodology, or key arguments across multiple dimensions (objectives, hypotheses, methods, evidence chains, and limitations) to streamline research notes.

claim_citation_alignment.description: Claim-faithfulness (L3) verification: compare manuscript assertions with cited source conclusions to detect out-of-context citations and ungrounded claims.

academic_style_audit.description: Academic style calibration & de-AI-ification: audit and eliminate hollow buzzwords (delve, testament to), vague quantifiers, and unsubstantiated superlatives while preserving the author's scholarly voice.

peer_review_evaluation.description: Multi-perspective peer review evaluation: simulate Editor-in-Chief, methodology reviewers, and Devil's Advocate to critique validity and rigor on a 0-100 rubric with actionable recommendations.

rebuttal_matrix_coach.description: Point-by-point rebuttal matrix coach: decompose reviewer critique into actionable revision matrices, guiding evidence additions and line-by-line response letters.

author_disclosure_statement.description: CRediT author contributions & ethics disclosure generator: create formalized Contributor Roles Taxonomy statements, AI assistance statements, and conflict of interest declarations.

bibtex_format_converter.description: Bibliographic format converter & BibTeX normalizer: convert publication metadata or freeform references into standard BibTeX and APA 7.0 citations.
